rule: Category label is never an answer.
Settlement must resolve to instrument, period, component streams, departments, amounts and restrictions where published.
Funding must separate taxpayer, Lottery, local tax, tax relief, philanthropy, sponsorship and earned income.
Decision authority must name body/person and the exact power exercised.
Judgement mechanism must identify assessors/criteria/appointment route or state not evidenced.
Scrutiny must identify body, membership route, powers, limits, call-in/appeal/audit mechanics.
Capacity is observable evidence only: staff/FTE, budget, programmes, years, application volume, panels, assets.
Strategy separates claim, action, measurable target, budget, deadline/responsible body.
Output and result are separate; causation is never inferred from co-occurrence.
Unknown/not evidenced is preferable to an unverified generalisation.
Every substantive fact resolves to primary source + precise locator under C32.
Public name and legal/reporting entity remain separate.
